mainEntity.name: How do I calculate square feet from feet and inches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Convert each side to decimal feet by dividing the inches by 12 and adding them to the feet, then multiply. A 12 ft 6 in by 9 ft 3 in room is 12.5 × 9.25 = 115.63 square feet.

mainEntity.name: How much waste should I add for flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Five to 10% covers a simple rectangular room. Use about 15% for diagonal layouts, herringbone, or rooms with many angles or doorways.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between square feet and linear feet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Square feet measure area, length times width. Linear feet measure length only, for things such as baseboards or fencing. The Perimeter option shows the linear feet around a rectangular room.

mainEntity.name: How do I measure an L-shaped room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Split the room into two rectangles, calculate each and add them. In this tool, add each rectangle to the ledger and read the total.

mainEntity.name: How many square feet are in a square yard?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are 9 square feet in a square yard, because a yard is 3 feet and 3 × 3 = 9. Carpet is often sold by the square yard.
